I called three clinics in Kata-Karon before I finally contacted BeCare. The first three only tried to get me in the door and wouldn't or couldn't answer some basic questions about available services and fees. My 4th call to the BeCare folks was perfect.

Great communication, and quoted me fees and services regarding what I was inguiring about, and then sent me directions on my preferred messaging app.

All the front staff were friendly, polite and caring.

The doctor was great, diagnosed my problem well, and prescribed sensible care.

I never felt as if I was being taken advantage of either, and I was not given any tests or medicines that were not warranted.

So, on top of great professional care, it was reasonabley priced and a value.

I highly recommend BeCare.

Honest doctor. Friendly staff. He recommended I can wait and didn’t need to do the procedure. I still did it. But the point is he’s not after your money. The price was much less than the PMC (franchise) quote I got. I paid less than 2500. I got quoted 6-8k and 10k plus at hospital. Great option if you you didn’t buy health insurance. Antiseptic protocols seemed on point. Had the meds I needed and didn’t screw me over because I’m pharang lol

I visited the clinic today because my ear got plugged after snorkeling. The welcoming was sweet and professional. They helped me with the insurance and kindly led me into the examination room. Everything was clear and modern. The doctor speaks English fluently and he is very friendly. After the treatment, ai got all the necessary pills and medicine as well. They dealt with my insurance company, I had nothing to worry about. I love Thailand even more after this. <3 Thanks for everything!

Excellent service. I came here for an eye infection (be careful of the water in Phuket). The staff at reception and the doctor were all very competent and friendly. Everything was explained very well and I left with a sense of ease and they provided the antibiotics.

I recently visited Becare Medical Clinic in Kata, and I couldn't be more impressed with my experience. The doctor was exceptionally professional, taking the time to listen to my concerns and explaining everything clearly. The atmosphere was …

This is a good clinic. We came here with food poisoning. They processed everything very quickly, listened to us carefully, and sent us to the doctor. They quickly took our tests and started treating us. Both the doctor and the nurses were very attentive. The treatment was effective. I definitely recommend this clinic.

Had to get rabies shots here. The doctor was totally professional. After testing for allergies, we paid for the Hreg immuno globin, costing ~£270 incl. first round of vaccination as well as antibiotic course.

The doctor gave us all necessary information, and has helped us through the process immensely. Could not recommend more if ever you need to get rabies shots.

Highly professional doctor and staff, I feel very assured. It’s a major bummer to be unwell on a vacation, and I had a severe case of food poisoning. I’m glad I found this clinic in Kata. From the moment I stepped in the staff were very professional and spoke good English and the doctor was very patient and kind and took time to explain his diagnosis and treatment. After taking the medicine and resting for 24h I feel much much better. Strongly recommend travellers to visit this clinic if you feel unwell

I had follow up for changing a dressing for 9 days in a row. The doctor and staff were very professional and caring. They were open every day over the christmas break. Would recommend BeCare Medical Clinic Kata.

My girlfriend had food poisoning. We arrived at 8 a.m., and they immediately took care of her—very professional and kind. They even checked her blood before administering medication.
The nurses and the doctor are verry kind. They always came by and checked how she felt.

I absolutely recommend this clinic.
If you ever need to see a doctor in phuket go here! Exceptional service and treatment, speak very good English and always helpful and attentive. 😀 …
Been many times for different small health issues over the years. Staff are incredibly kind and the clinic is very clean. 5/5.
I came for 3 days to take Antibiotics, intravenously. The service was professional and the place was clean and comfortable. I recommend!

My friend and I both had sinus issues after scuba diving and came here. The staff was so kind and Dr. Raomad was very thorough. A few days after our initial visit, I got stung by a jellyfish while out surfing and had an unusual reaction. We …
very friendly staff, been well taken care of. the doctor is very fluent in english that made me feel comfortable in my treatment 👍 …

While travelling in Phuket, I injured my knee and needed medical attention. From the moment I walked into BeCare Medical Clinic in Kata, I felt at ease. The doctor was thorough, patient, and truly listened — he took the time to understand my symptoms, answer all of my questions, and explain everything clearly.

The entire team was warm, kind, and professional, and I felt genuinely cared for during a stressful situation. I left with the treatment I needed and peace of mind. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this clinic to anyone needing medical support while abroad — they made a difficult moment feel much easier to manage.

The doctor was good I seen.  He had good knowledge and was able to immediately diagnose the problem and give good advice.

The medicine I was quoted was 1300baht.

I refused and went to a local pharmacy and the exact same medicine was 510baht.

Considering the local pharmacy has to mark up their price to make a profit, how much are BeCare Medical Clinic overcharging  customers? 300% at least?

I'd recommend going here for the doctor but questioning the cost of any medicine you're prescribed at the counter.

My experience with the clinic was very good. I have been there a total of 4 times. The staff were always friendly, the waiting times were short and the whole clinic made a good impression. The doctor speaks good English and was always able to explain my current state of health (I had dengue fever and had to go back several times for check-ups). I would go there again.

We took our 3 children here when our family become very ill as a result of contaminated food. We can't say enough great things about the staff at this clinic. They were caring, compassionate and efficient. And they were supposed to close at …

The doctors and nurses at this medical centre are some of the best in the world that we have used. My son had sunburn really bad on his shoulders and they treated him so well and were so gentle and patience with him. Highly Highly recommend this medical centre

Fantastic service, the nurses and Dr speak fluent English. My partner ended up having a bacterial infection that resulted in severe vomiting and stomach pain, the Dr was able to do a blood test and give results within 15 minutes. Medication provided with clear instructions. Highly recommend

From the moment we walked in, we knew we'd be in good care. The nurses & doctor were all so calming & reassuring. My partner & I had some intense bacterial poisoning & we ended up needing some IV/electrolytes & antibiotics. The doctor took time to explain everything & everyone was professional. The clinic was very clean & sterileas well. Would recommend to anyone dealing with health issues near Kata. Thank you again 🙏🏻

The doctor and nurses were so helpful, my daughter had an ear infection while we were on holidays in Thailand, we visited this doctor and he had high tech camera that could look inside her ear, he then gave her a treatment and used an …

I was super sick after 1st day open water dive. Had to call the doctor to my room.
They responded very fast via email and visited me shortly.
Doctor and nurse were very polite and professional. Doctor took my blood sample back to run a quick test, and within 20 mins he got the result and get back to the hotel with the correct medicine.
Super smooth and well organized.
Appreciate their care, I recovered very fast. Meds worked very well🙏🏼

My experience at Becare Medical Team was exceptional. I visited the clinic on March 20, 2024, due to food poisoning, and I received top-notch care from their team. The staff were professional, attentive, and knowledgeable, making me feel at …

The staff is amazing. Professional and sweet and caring. I felt very safe in their hands. They explained everything they were doing and made sure that I felt safe. They even stayed an hour after closing to make sure I got the treatments i needed! I am very thankfull for this experience as it can be quite scary being sick abroad. Thank you so much. :)

Professional and transparent service
I visited for a middle ear inflammation - the doctor was well educated and explained everything using a camera, while the nurse was quick and attentive. …

Had to go there during my stay because of an ear problem. The nurses were extremely friendly and helpful, there was no waiting time for me and the doctor was very kind, helpful and professional. Their English was really good too and I received all papers necessary for my travel insurance without even having to ask. If you need medical care here, I'd definitely recommend this place. I felt very well taken care of and big thanks to the whole team!

Extremely happy a with fast private service by English speaking Dr & nurses. Service was complete for my suspected and confirmed food poisoning. They gave fast results at the time for blood test results & gave 2x Saline IV electrolytes & …

I visited this clinic when I had a very serious live bacterial infection and I received excellent service and care here. I was on drips for fluids, antibiotics and other medications for several hours and then received all of he required medications I needed for the following week. The doctor said I’d gradually get better and should be perfect after 7 days and that’s exactly how it worked out. Nurses and doctor were excellent and very friendly and great English.

As everyone mentioned Dr and staff were kind and gave all the information I needed for my treatment (middle ear infection). I was also very happy to be treated straight away without waiting. The initial Dr consultation/visit was 700 Baht …

Exceptional clinic, I came into the clinic in a lot of pain from a bladder infection. The doctor saw me in under 5 minutes, took a sample, and was able to determine the severity of my infection just 10 minutes later. The doctor listened to my concerns and was very kind and knowledgeable. They had all the medications I needed in the clinic, so no extra trips to the pharmacy required. I was in and out in 20 minutes, and it cost me about $100 USD. Incredible. I couldn’t recommend this clinic more! Thank you so much! I will be back if I ever feel the least bit poorly.

Great experience! Very welcoming and caring!

I visited this clinic to get stitches removed that another clinic in Koh Lanta …

Very good care, doctor is very patient and careful around wounds and is respectful about your fears. Nurses are also great. They take care great care of you and are very helpful. Overall, one of the best clinics on Phuket, they explain everything perfectly and also give medicine and explain procedures how to take care of your illness/wounds. I went there with monkey bite, they greatly took care of my wound and explained which shot is for what and gave me medicine to clean the wound and meds to take.

Had to take my son because he had quite bad quinsy, were were seen quickly and given antibiotics intravenously and orally. The doctor has very good English and very knowledgeable. Cleared up within 24hours. I would highly recommend. …

Great staff and doctor. Speaks English well enough and are super helpful. They keep good hygiene and knows their stuff. They cleaned my husbands would, did basic bloodwork and gave iv antibiotics. Great way to avoid a stay at the hospital.

While travelling in Phuket my family became quite ill with a stomach bug.  The care we received at BeCare Medical Clinic Kata was wonderful.  The staff was so caring and and kind.  The staff worked late into the night (after closing time)caring for us and the doctor even drove us back to our hotel.  Thank you so much you are wonderful people!

I can highly recommend this clinic. Because of a monkey bite, my friend had to go to the wound care every day. The staff took care of the wound extremely well. The doctor also checked it daily. She got the vaccinations done there as well. We were extremely happy and thankful with the help and professional care. Thank you very much!

I cannot thank this team enough. I became violently sick with what we suspected was Dengue Fever a few days ago. I arrived at their clinic, they assisted me straight away. Everything was straight forward and their English was great. I was …

Excellent service!
Everybody was very friendly and caring, I felt treated very well when I injured my foot.

The doctor explains everything perfectly. He and the receptionist speak very good English, and answered all of my many questions with great patience.
The price was absolutely fair and you can even pay by credit card, which is a big plus I think.

Thank you all a lot!
Highly recommended when in need of medical treatment or advice in Kata.

Nobody usually enjoys going to a medical clinic while on holidays…but I did!  I had a bad case of diver’s ear.  The appointment was easily made, and I was seen right at my appointment time.  The clinic staff was thorough, caring, and …
Visit for certificate for driver license   just 200 baht really fast 5 min finish  good clinic any one need certificated  recommend this clinic

Our 11 month old got quite sick. We took him here and couldn’t have been more pleased with the treatment. Immediately they started doing his observations and after 1 patient in front of us he was taken in to see the doctor. All in all it took around half an hour, and we walked out with a diagnosis, all medicines and a secure plan B if they didn’t work.
I highly recommend for anyone seeking treatment, especially families with young children. You’re in good hands here.
Highly recommend. Visited here as a tourist. Diagnosed with acute gastroenteritis. Clinic were able to do blood test and IV drip on site. Doctor spoke clear and good English.
Wasn’t feeling well and found this clinic. The doctor and nurse were amazing. So helpful, so attentive, so careful. I have nothing but good things to say. Everything was clean too which is great.

I came here with a severe ear infection. First pleasant surprise was that the clinic opens very early in the morning: we dropped by to make an appointment and the nurse immediately called the doctor who arrived within 25 minutes. Everyone …

Excellent care from this clinic. The doctor and nurse that came out were very thorough and explained everything and provided all the necessary medication. The messaging service is brilliant and they check to see how you are afterwards. They also honour travel insurance. Thank you, would highly recommend

I visited Phuket early November 2019 and became very unwell with an acute infection. After searching the immediate area from where I was staying I found BeCare Medical clinic. This facility is very clean and the nursing staff welcomed me …

I am a physician who worked for the last 24 years at Canada’s largest and most prestigious hospital. I went this morning to the clinic for an acute hearing issue. Dr Roamad and his assistant were kind, professional and VERY helpful. The clinic is ultra clean and well equipped. They rapidly diagnosed the cause of my problem and did the proper procedure to solve the issue. The even e-mailed me pictures of my ear obtained by otoscopic examination!
Kudos!!! I would recommend this clinic without any hesitation.

We had an unfortunate accident coming down the hill on a scooter after heavy rainfall, but were so lucky that this wonderful  clinic was right around the corner! We were received immediately and the doctor spent a couple of hours fixing us …

text: Walked into the clinic due to a blocked ear and very quickly saw a doctor. The nurses and doctor were all very professional and helpful and provided post treatment medication and relevant certificates/reports of needed for travel insurance.
Thank you sinwa for your service and your smile ❤️❤️❤️
Great, everything was fast and clear, the ear plug was removed in no time.

Incredibly clean, comfortable and good medical center. Skilled staff and fluent in English. I felt very safe in their hands and received the help/treatment I needed. Recommend to anyone who needs fast and good medical treatment!
The staff provided excellent service.
very professional!
I applied for insurance for a leg injury. The staff was polite and professional.
We got into the clinic through insurance, excellent specialists and service

I came to the clinic with severe food poisoning. They immediately accepted me and started treating me. The examination was professional and courteous, and they were very kind throughout. During the treatment, they arranged everything with the insurance company, so I didn't have to pay anything. The doctor and his team are both excellent professionals, they speak fluent English and are also extremely empathetic. I would like to thank you once again for your quick help, I got better within a few hours!

They are the best 🙏🏻❤️
Excellent service
Thank you 🫶🏼 …

My child had inflammation on his body that wouldn't go away, so I visited. After applying the prescribed medicine and ointment, he completely recovered. The doctors and nurses were all friendly, the hospital was clean, and the doctor's explanations were detailed and helpful. They also provided excellent insurance documentation. The director Googled photos and provided interpretation to explain everything. Highly recommended!👍🏻
A doctor of dubious qualifications and 800 baht for a sort of "visit" and 2800 baht plus the cost of the medicine for an intramuscular injection. Ridiculous.

Excellent facility, as well as the staff.
My partner and I went here for severe food poisoning, and after taking blood samples and administering IVs, they gave us a diagnosis, along with the necessary medications, explaining everything to us perfectly.
It's not nice to feel sick on vacation, but if that happens, I highly recommend this clinic!
Thank you for everything!!

On December 2, 2025, my wife felt ill. We got there through T Bank insurance, and it turned out to be a bacterial infection. She lay there with an IV for a couple of hours, and it felt much better, and they gave her a bunch of medications. On December 3, 2025, my child (1.5 years old) and I felt ill, and we arrived – the same thing happened, they took blood for a test, and the attitude was great. They open at 8 a.m., not 7:30 a.m., as Google says.

Both my boyfriend and I (unfortunately) needed medical attention during our vacation in Phuket: he for a cut on his finger, and I for a bad case of gastroenteritis. We were referred to this clinic by our health insurance and had a wonderful experience. Everyone is so kind and sweet, but above all, so gentle and patient. They handled everything with great sensitivity and care, even when I mentioned how scared I was of needles. Both the nurses and the doctor were so patient and made sure I didn't feel anything. During such a difficult time, they were able to reassure us and make us feel as good as possible. Thank you! ❤️
A good clinic with attentive staff. They provided prompt and professional care to my family after the poisoning.

Excellent clinic! We went with our insurance. I (an adult) and my 7-year-old child had food poisoning, which turned out to be bacterial. The doctor and nurses were attentive and excellent, no questions at all! They were great. They gave us IVs and plenty of medication to take with us, so he'll be able to finish his treatment. Thank you!

On November 18, 2025, we brought a young man with severe poisoning to the clinic, covered by insurance. They took a blood sample, measured his blood pressure and oxygen levels, and started an IV. We are incredibly grateful for the help. The …
A good clinic. My daughter and I went there, then my wife. Before they thoughtlessly gave us antibiotics, they ran tests, checked everything, and prescribed treatment.

Amazing clinic, wonderful doctor and staff!
I felt ill overnight, thinking I might have been poisoned. I contacted my insurance company, and they referred me to this clinic early in the morning. I arrived in the morning, they immediately took a blood sample, started an IV, and after a while, the results came back, and it turned out it wasn't just poisoning, but a bacterial infection.
They also treated me with an IV and antibiotics. They explained everything in detail and gave me all the medications I needed to take, each in a separate packet, so everything was clear.
The staff spoke English, and when we didn't understand, we used a translator. But I think those who speak English well will understand everything easily.

I left the clinic feeling much better! Thank you to the clinic staff for such a warm, responsive, and pleasant approach!
Doctor spoke fluent English& the nurses were lovely and made me feel really comfortable, thanks again

A good clinic. We visited general practitioner Armeena through our insurance with a small child. She was very attentive and pleasant, and explained everything step by step in English. We were also pleased that the clinic manager, Kirill, speaks Russian. At the end, he explained the prescription again and translated it into Russian. The medications, labeled in Russian and with the recommended dosage, were also provided through our insurance. We LIKED EVERYTHING.
Excellent clinic! They helped me quickly while I was in Phuket.
This clinic is fantastic, I was in and out within 10 minutes, the nurses were very kind and the clinic was very clean

text: Visiting the doctor is never pleasant, but this clinic makes entering a lot nicer.
Super helpful friendly and efficient! Thank you so much

While on vacation in Thailand, we had an unpleasant incident: my girlfriend became very ill on the way to an excursion and developed severe motion sickness. We used this medical center through our insurance, and it was a great decision.

We were seen very quickly, and I'd especially like to thank the doctor who saw us—unfortunately, we didn't remember his name, but he really did his best. He was very attentive and calm, explained everything in detail, made decisions quickly, and oversaw the entire process.

They gave my girlfriend an IV, took a blood sample, compiled a report, and gave her the necessary medications. Within an hour, she felt much better. It's clear that they are professionals, yet they have a human touch.

The center, although small, is clean, tidy, and equipped with everything necessary. Thank you so much for the high-quality care and assistance. We highly recommend it!

We needed help for our son who had an ear infection. The doctor gave us full information about what was happening. We learned that the infection was progressing and presented solutions that would accommodate our flight home. The ear was …

We've been to the clinic twice with our child. Once, we got something in our eye (the doctor examined us and prescribed medication), and the second time, it was poisoning (they gave us an IV, a blood test, a treatment plan, and a full course of pills). Clean and tidy!
